# a11y-eco rules

<!-- Generated by `a11y-eco rules --format markdown --lang en`: do not edit by hand. -->

34 rules.

## Accessibility (RGAA)

| Rule | Severity | Reference | What it checks |
|---|---|---|---|
| `A11Y-LANG-MISSING` | error | RGAA 8.3 | The default language of the page must be declared on the html element. |
| `A11Y-LANG-INVALID` | error | RGAA 8.4 | The declared default language must be a well-formed language code. |
| `A11Y-PAGE-TITLE` | error | RGAA 8.5 | The page must have a title, the first thing a screen reader announces. |
| `A11Y-IMG-ALT` | error | RGAA 1.1 | Every image must have a text alternative, empty when the image is decorative. |
| `A11Y-HEADING-H1-MISSING` | warning | RGAA 9.1 | The page should have a level 1 heading. |
| `A11Y-HEADING-H1-MULTIPLE` | info | RGAA 9.1 | Several level 1 headings are allowed, but often reveal a structure problem. |
| `A11Y-HEADING-SKIP` | error | RGAA 9.1 | A heading must not be more than one level below the previous heading. |
| `A11Y-HEADING-EMPTY` | error | RGAA 9.1 | A heading must have text, possibly the alternative of an image. |
| `A11Y-ARIA-LABELLEDBY` | error | RGAA 8.2 | Every id listed in aria-labelledby must exist in the page. |
| `A11Y-LINK-NAME` | error | RGAA 6.2 | Every link must have an accessible name. |
| `A11Y-BUTTON-NAME` | error | RGAA 11.9 | Every button must have an accessible name. |

## Eco-design (RWEB), read from the HTML

| Rule | Severity | Reference | What it checks |
|---|---|---|---|
| `ECO-REQUESTS` | warning | RWEB_0047 | The page should not make more than 40 requests when it loads. |
| `ECO-STYLESHEETS` | warning | RWEB_0035 | The page should not load more than 10 stylesheets. |
| `ECO-DOMAINS` | warning | RWEB_0082 | The page and its resources should not come from more than 5 domains. |
| `ECO-INLINE-CODE` | info | RWEB_0042 | Large blocks of CSS and JavaScript should be in external files, which browsers can cache. |
| `ECO-MEDIA-AUTOLOAD` | warning | RWEB_0106 | Audio and video should only be downloaded when the user asks for them. |
| `ECO-LAZY-LOADING` | info | RWEB_0051 | Images and frames that may be out of view should be loaded lazily. |
| `ECO-EMBEDDED-DOCUMENT` | warning | RWEB_0033 | Documents (PDF, office files) should be linked to, not displayed in the page. |
| `ECO-GIF` | info | RWEB_0099 | Animations should be videos rather than GIF images, which are much heavier. |
| `ECO-WEB-FONTS` | info | RWEB_0032 | The page should not download more than 2 fonts. |
| `ECO-CANVAS` | info | RWEB_0055 | A canvas is redrawn by script: HTML and CSS are often enough, and lighter. |
| `ECO-VIEWPORT` | info | RWEB_0004 | The page should declare a viewport, so that mobile browsers do not shrink a desktop page. |
| `ECO-TITLE` | warning | RWEB_0011 | The page should have a title, so that people and search engines find it at once. |
| `ECO-META-DESCRIPTION` | warning | RWEB_0011 | The page should have a meta description, which summarises it in search results. |
| `ECO-ANALYTICS` | warning | RWEB_0111 | The page should use one analytics tool at most. |
| `ECO-SOCIAL-BUTTONS` | warning | RWEB_0059 | Social networks should be reached through plain links, not their heavy official scripts. |
| `ECO-CAROUSEL` | info | RWEB_0010 | The page should have one carousel at most. |
| `ECO-ANIMATIONS` | warning | RWEB_0009 | The page should not have more than 2 animations. |
| `ECO-SVG-METADATA` | warning | RWEB_0100 | Inline SVG should be cleaned of the metadata left by drawing tools. |

## Eco-design (RWEB), with --fetch-resources

| Rule | Severity | Reference | What it checks |
|---|---|---|---|
| `ECO-COMPRESSION` | warning | RWEB_0076 | HTML, CSS, JavaScript and SVG files should be sent compressed (gzip, Brotli). |
| `ECO-CACHE-HEADERS` | warning | RWEB_0075 | Static files should say how long to keep them, with Expires or Cache-Control. |
| `ECO-COOKIE-DOMAINS` | warning | RWEB_0081 | Static files should come from at most one domain that uses cookies. |
| `ECO-REDIRECTS` | warning | RWEB_0112 | Loading the page should not go through more than one redirection. |
| `ECO-IMAGE-SIZE` | info | RWEB_0048 | Images should not be much larger than their display size, high-density screens included. |
